name: Kanibar
author: erfoip
description: WaniKani reviews and lessons at a glance, with a detail popup for the review forecast and your level.

barWidget.description: Pending WaniKani reviews and lessons. Click for the 24-hour forecast; middle-click refreshes.

schema.label: WaniKani API token
schema.description: A read-only personal access token from wanikani.com/settings/personal_access_tokens. Leave empty to read it from ~/.config/kanibar/token instead.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: Kanibar also refreshes right after each full hour, when new reviews unlock.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is due
schema.description: Hide the bar pill while there are no reviews or lessons available.

schema.label: Highlight at reviews
schema.description: Color the pill with the urgent color once this many reviews are waiting. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Daily review reminder
schema.description: Send a notification at the time below if reviews are still waiting. If the computer is asleep then, it reminds you on wake (until midnight).

schema.label: Remind at reviews
schema.description: Only remind when at least this many reviews are waiting.
